commands.review_summary:
The PR recognizes Loom share/embed URLs and routes them through the existing generic yt-dlp transcription pipeline, with audio-selection, CLI failure-handling, Chrome/daemon routing, documentation, and regression-test changes.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: the linked issue provides an exact Loom CLI failure path, and the remaining redirect, embedded-media substitution, and cache-order cases are concrete current-head code paths. This read-only review did not run artifact-producing tests.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The contributor should resolve the three current-head findings and supply successful real-provider proof; the setup-specific proof requirement keeps this PR out of automated repair and merge lanes.

target.title: fix: support Loom transcript extraction
target.body:
## Summary

- recognize strict Loom share/embed video URLs as media-like inputs for CLI/core transcript routing
- route Loom through the existing generic yt-dlp transcription pipeline
- ensure audio transcription cannot select a video-only fallback
- reject explicit `--video-mode transcript` Loom failures as a real CLI/non-zero failure (not empty successful extract content with the error only in diagnostics)
- prefer-mode still discovers embedded captions from Loom HTML before yt-dlp, without returning landing-page text
- disable shared embedded-YouTube URL substitution during Loom caption HTML discovery (`embeddedMediaUrl: null`)
- always pass the original Loom share/embed URL to yt-dlp (never embedded CDN renditions)
- harden Loom URL matching against nonstandard ports, credentials, and uppercase IDs
- do **not** hard-prefer Loom in the shared `shouldPreferUrlMode(...)` policy used by Chrome/daemon auto routing (guarded environments cannot pass unresolved Loom URLs to yt-dlp)
- add focused regression coverage and documentation

## Root cause

1. Loom share/embed URLs were not classified as known media URLs for CLI/core transcript routing, so the generic transcript provider could return `generic/not_implemented` for public Loom pages.
2. The shared yt-dlp audio selector allowed unconstrained `best` fallbacks. For hosts with split HLS (including Loom), that can resolve to a video-only rendition and fail with `Media has no audio stream`.
3. Even after Loom routing, explicit prefer-mode transcript failures could fall through the HTML pipeline and surface Loom landing-page text as successful extract output.
4. Embedded/og:video CDN URLs could replace the Loom share URL before yt-dlp, risking video-only signed renditions.
5. The URL extraction session treated all `shouldPreferUrlMode` failures as best-effort URL-only empty successes. Because Loom was briefly prefer-url-mode, CLI prefer failures were swallowed into empty successful extracts with the real error buried in diagnostics.
6. The Loom prefer transcript-only strategy initially called `resolveTranscriptForLink(url, null, ...)`, so embedded `<track kind="captions|subtitles">` discovery never ran on the real prefer path.
7. Passing Loom HTML into `resolveTranscriptForLink` without `embeddedMediaUrl: null` allowed incidental YouTube iframes to replace the Loom URL before the generic provider ran.
8. Including Loom in the shared `shouldPreferUrlMode(...)` helper hard-routed Chrome/daemon requests into URL/video extraction even though guarded daemon URL flows intentionally disable yt-dlp for unresolved URLs, causing page-text discard / hard-fail / landing-page cache regressions.

## Implementation

- Added `isLoomVideoUrl(...)` with structured URL parsing for `http(s)://loom.com|www.loom.com` `share`/`embed` paths and a lowercase 32-hex video id; lookalike hosts, non-web protocols, nonstandard ports, credentials, folders, and community pages are rejected. Query strings, fragments, and a trailing slash remain supported.
- Updated the generic transcript provider to attempt `fetchDirectMediaTranscript(...)` for Loom in both `auto` and `prefer` modes, always passing the original Loom URL with `mediaKind: "video"` and `service: "generic"`. Embedded captions still win first when present.
- Added a prefer-mode Loom entry to `TRANSCRIPT_ONLY_STRATEGIES` so explicit transcript failures throw with yt-dlp/provider diagnostics instead of returning page HTML. Prefer mode may fetch Loom HTML only as optional caption-discovery input and passes `embeddedMediaUrl: null` so shared YouTube substitution cannot hijack the Loom URL. HTML fetch failure still continues to yt-dlp with the original Loom URL. Auto mode still attempts Loom transcription via the normal HTML path, and may return page content if transcription is unavailable.
- Extraction-session catch policy rethrows for Loom URLs when `options.mediaTranscript === "prefer"`, so the CLI surfaces a real failure instead of an empty URL-only success shell.
- Loom is intentionally **not** included in shared `shouldPreferUrlMode(...)`. Chrome/daemon auto routing therefore keeps using supplied page text for Loom unless the user explicitly selects video mode. CLI/core Loom transcript support continues via direct `isLoomVideoUrl(...)` checks.
- Constrained `DEFAULT_AUDIO_FORMAT` so every combined `best` fallback requires `[acodec!=none]`; audio-only remains preferred first.
- Docs/changelog updates for the above behaviour. Guarded-daemon external-downloader policy unchanged.

Explicitly:

- no Loom API scraper was added
- no new provider was introduced
- the guarded daemon external-downloader policy was not weakened
- the audio-capable yt-dlp selector remains fail-closed (`[acodec!=none]` on every muxed fallback)
- ordinary HTML/page fallback was not re-enabled for Loom prefer mode
- Loom was not left in the shared Chrome/daemon URL hard-preference policy

## Verification

```text
pnpm -s test \
  tests/content.url.test.ts \
  tests/transcript.generic.video-tag.test.ts \
  tests/transcript.yt-dlp.test.ts \
  tests/link-preview.media-transcript-prefer.test.ts \
  tests/link-preview.loom-prefer-captions.test.ts \
  tests/run.url-extraction-session.test.ts \
  tests/run.url-external-media.test.ts \
  tests/chrome.media-extraction-plan.test.ts \
  tests/daemon.auto-mode.test.ts \
  tests/chrome.daemon-payload.test.ts \
  tests/chrome.panel-content-preparation.test.ts \
  tests/chrome.panel-summarize.test.ts \
  tests/chrome.extractor-router.test.ts \
  tests/chrome.extract-cache-loom.test.ts
# → 14 files / 125 tests passed

pnpm -C apps/chrome-extension test:chrome
# → 107 passed, 5 skipped; 1 unrelated browser-slides permission failure
#   (`Either the '<all_urls>' or 'activeTab' permission is required.`)

pnpm -s check
# → format, lint, typecheck, and coverage gates passed

pnpm -s build
# → passed

git diff --check
# → clean
```

## Live behaviour proof

Public fixture: `https://www.loom.com/share/ef3224a48a084371bd6d766ee81f083f`

**yt-dlp extractor / audio-capable selection**

```text
$ yt-dlp --print '%(extractor)s|%(id)s|%(duration)s' --skip-download <loom-url>
loom|ef3224a48a084371bd6d766ee81f083f|3076

selected format with audio-capable selector:
hls-raw-audio-audio
```

**ffprobe audio codec** (yt-dlp `-x --audio-format mp3`):

```text
codec_name=mp3
codec_type=audio
```

**Built CLI: explicit prefer failure is a real reject**

```text
$ node dist/cli.js <loom-url> --extract --video-mode transcript --json --no-cache --no-media-cache
# exit=1
# stdout empty (no successful empty JSON extract)
# stderr:
Failed to transcribe Loom video (... Missing transcription provider ...)
```

**Built CLI: auto mode remains best-effort for page content**

```text
$ node dist/cli.js <loom-url> --extract --video-mode auto --json --no-cache --no-media-cache
# exit=0
# returns page/title content when transcription is unavailable
# diagnostics retain the missing-provider note
```

**Chrome/daemon routing**

- Loom is not universally hard-preferred via `shouldPreferUrlMode`
- daemon auto with supplied text: page primary, URL fallback
- default Chrome Loom summarize payload does not become `mode=url` + `videoMode=transcript` unless video mode is explicit
- Chrome chat caches readable page extraction for Loom instead of guarded URL-only landing-page extraction

**Built CLI: original Loom URL + audio selector reach yt-dlp**

With a transcription capability present and media cache disabled, yt-dlp was invoked as:

```text
-f bestaudio[vcodec=none]/best[height<=360][acodec!=none]/best[height<=480][acodec!=none]/best[height<=720][acodec!=none]/best[acodec!=none]
-x --audio-format mp3
… https://www.loom.com/share/ef3224a48a084371bd6d766ee81f083f
```

Live end-to-end transcription was not completed here because no real transcription provider API key / whisper.cpp install was available. Deterministic unit/integration coverage proves successful `generic` + `yt-dlp` transcript shaping when a provider is configured, and high-level prefer coverage proves embedded caption discovery without invoking yt-dlp / without YouTube substitution.

## Security

Raw Loom URLs were not allowed to bypass the daemon’s guarded fetch/external-downloader boundary. `resolveUrlFlowYtDlpPath(...)` is unchanged; guarded daemon URL flow still does not pass arbitrary unresolved URLs to yt-dlp. `tests/run.url-external-media.test.ts` remains green. Loom was removed from shared URL preference specifically to avoid forcing guarded environments into a yt-dlp-dependent path they cannot run.

Fixes #353
